overview: In a sparse and inhospitable land, the policeman Enzo Vitello, a man with a dark past, is obsessed with "Dostoyevsky", a serial killer whom he kills with a peculiarity: next to the body, the murderer always leaves a letter with his desolate and very clear vision of the world, of life and darkness that Vitello hears resonating in him.
title: Dostoevskij

overview: Ahead of the highly anticipated 2025 Toyota AFL Premiership Season, the Seven Network has announced the Hawthorn Football Club will be the subject of a behind-the-scenes pre-season documentary, Full Sweat, to be broadcast exclusively on Seven and 7plus Sport. The multi-part docuseries will give AFL fans a unique, inner-sanctum look into the 2025 AFL pre-season, where Sam Mitchell's side will be aiming to build on their memorable 2024 finals berth. With key figures of the brown and gold set to feature, Seven will take viewers behind the scenes in an access all areas documentary, as the Hawks embark on one of their biggest years yet, both on and off the field. The unmissable documentary is set to be released before the 2025 AFL season gets underway on Seven and streamed on 7plus Sport.
title: Full Sweat

overview: Each year, Vision Australia's Carols by Candlelight brings families together as a cherished Australian tradition, featuring some of the biggest stars in music and musical theatre, all generously donating their time to support Vision Australia.
title: Vision Australia's Carols by Candlelight

overview: Ran Shuang, who was once the best trader on Wall Street, agreed to marry Fu Zhi Heng in order to repay his financial support. After three years of marriage, the two had not had sex. Ran Shuang thought that Fu Zhi Heng was thinking about his childhood sweetheart Lu Meng Lian. But in fact, it was because Fu Zhi Heng was abused by the nanny when he was a child, and he had a psychological shadow since then and could not have substantial contact with women. After being repeatedly ignored by Fu Zhi Heng, Ran Shuang decided to let go and leave, and Fu Zhi Heng gradually realized his feelings for Ran Shuang and resolutely pursued his wife.
title: Ascetic Love

overview: A woman was used as a fake daughter by her enemy and became the embodiment of revenge. She grows and heals as she realizes the true meaning of revenge.
title: Cinderella Game

overview: An extreme reality show in which working people from across the country compete for 10 million rubles. Leading the show is Olympic figure skating champion Roman Kostomarov.
title: Работяги

overview: We go behind the scenes at Bogota's El Dorado International Airport and take a closer look at what goes into keeping the third busiest airport in Latin America safe.
title: Airport Security: Colombia

overview: Three couples face bittersweet challenges in love: a farewell approaches, a relationship strains under conflict, and work disrupts holiday plans. What will their futures hold?
title: The Reason We Fall in Love

overview: Gino D'Acampo and Fred Sirieix go on an eco-friendly journey through Austria and Croatia. From glacier rowing to trying vegetarian options and agrotourism, they explore local culture while embracing sustainable travel.
title: Gino & Fred: Emission Impossible

overview: 10 men compete in a series of festive challenges that will showcase their acting chops and their holiday spirit. Jonathan Bennett hosts while these lovable guys vie to become the next Hallmark leading man.
title: Finding Mr. Christmas

overview: To get close to the indulgent warlord Yan Xuan, Jiang Yao, a member of the anti-warlord organization, Feiwu, pretends to be an item at an underground auction, hoping to be bidded by him. As the target is about to fall into the trap, Jiang Yao's plan is unexpectedly disrupted by a mysterious man who bids a high price for her. Only when the mysterious man walks into the spotlight does she realize that he is actually her old flame from five years ago—Chi Yanzhou! At present, Chi Yanzhou's loving gaze has turned glares of hatred. It turns out that he was the first target of the Feiwu Organization, and Jiang Yao, who has returned from studying abroad, is chosen as an undercover agent. With time and interactions, the two gradually fall in love. For the big picture, Jiang Yao ultimately chooses to complete the mission, but it indirectly leads to the death of Chi's father and the disappearance of Chi Yanzhou. When they reunite after a long time, Chi Yanzhou has become extremely powerful. With a heart for revenge, he tries every means to torture and humiliate Jiang Yao, both causing chaos in Jiang Yao's life and plunging into deeper agony.
title: Love Trap

overview: A Norwegian family vacationing on La Palma faces disaster when a young researcher discovers alarming signs of an imminent volcanic eruption.
title: La Palma

overview: In the midst of the epidemic, former criminal investigation operative Viktor Pugachev returns to his native Severoneftyansk, where the infection was known only from the news at that time. No one is happy for him here, because it is after his arrival that residents one by one begin to catch the coronavirus. The infection is spreading so fast that even the head of the criminal investigation department, David Yeghiazaryan, is ready to panic: the city is about to be quarantined, which means that the crime rate will rise sharply, and there is simply no one to fight it. The lieutenant colonel, in order to prepare for the worst-case scenario, gathers back his old department, which was dissolved five years ago due to the loss of important evidence. He can offer nothing but the certificates of the vigilante, nevertheless three out of four, including Pugachev, agree to work on these conditions, another promises to think about it. It quickly becomes clear to colleagues that the deadly epidemic is not the main reason why people in the city suddenly began to die more often than usual…
title: Пустые города

overview: 1953. After Stalin's death, there was more work in MUR. A new era had arrived - hundreds of criminals were released. The spirit of permissiveness swept across Moscow. Aleksandr Ivanovich Smirnov, the head of the operational group of the first department of MUR, has a lot of work - new murders and robberies occur in the city every day... Film adaptations of Anatoly Stepanov's novels "The Concerns of the Fifty-Third", "The Wooden Samovar", "The Pilgrims' Halt".
title: МУР есть МУР

overview: Power Play, a daily look at Canada's political landscape. Recorded in Ottawa featuring all the political news and issues that matter most. Hosted by CTV's Vassy Kapelos, the program is a must for political insiders.
title: Power Play with Vassy Kapelos

overview: The protagonist is Dr. Gretchen Haase who causes turmoil not only in the surgical ward but also in the hearts of her colleagues. After a disastrous relationship Gretchen goes back to the house of her parents, a professor of surgery and a competent uber-mother. Gretchen's aim is to finally pursue her career and to forget men. She copes with professional adventures in a charming and unselfish manner - but her love-life soon becomes chaotic. Her new senior physician, Dr. Marc Meier, is not only the worst macho in the department, he also happens to be Gretchen's long-term teenage heartthrob. Or does the good-natured gynaecologist Dr. Mehdi Kaan maybe have the better cards? Gretchen Haase never presents herself as a goddess in a white overall, but she remains a very normal woman who pursues her career, yet always listens to her heart. And her heart does not always beat rationally. From the standpoint of an imperfect and witty protagonist the genre "Medical" becomes amusing family entertainment with addiction potential. Finally we have the proof: doctors are only human. They tell lies, fall in love and suffer. And for obesity and love sickness a cure has yet to be found.
title: Doctor's Diary

overview: A road trip across Europe. An adventure full of little clues and deceptive images. A scavenger hunt in which eight celebrities constantly ask themselves ONE question: Where am I? In Destination X, eight celebrities go on a blind road trip. Their challenge: They have to determine their whereabouts as accurately as possible. Their travel companion: The opaque "Destination X" bus, which knows its secret routes but leaves its passengers in the dark.
title: Destination X

overview: Jonathan Ross returns to the scenes of his youth, to discover the darker side of London's East End and the sinister secrets hidden within.
title: Jonathan Ross Haunted Homecoming

overview: Set against the backdrop of traditional dragon boat racing in southern China, separated cousins reunite after a family tragedy. Answering the call of the race, they break through barriers of bloodline and rebuild familial bonds. Together, they join the competition, mending relationships, forging friendships, and discovering life's purpose.
title: The Way Home

overview: This drama tells the story of Fang Wanzhi, a post-70s woman who leaves the mountains of Southwest China to build a life in Shenzhen. It begins with her breaking free from the constraints of her family. Through life's hardships, she finds her true worth. It's also a powerful reflection of the deep connection between individual destiny and Reform and Opening-up.
title: My Destiny

overview: In the recent past, Lenka was a police officer. Who would have thought that at some point he would become completely disillusioned with the system and become one of the most wanted criminals in the country?
title: Жизнь и смерть Леньки Пантелеева

overview: The series follows a group of people and their lives in the social network.
title: Add a Friend

overview: Alevtina, a student of the Faculty of Law, goes to her grandmother's summer practice in Nesvizh. On the way, the girl meets a strange man Grigory, who tells her the legend about the Radziwills' treasures. Berlin during the Third Reich, Nesvizh in 1942 and the present serve as a historical background against which exciting events unfold in the search for the family heirloom of the Radziwill family - the golden statues of the Twelve Holy Apostles. Legends and reality, secrets and mysticism, murder and love intertwined in this search and confrontation between Soviet and German intelligence, members of occult societies and other heroes of the film.
title: Следы апостолов

overview: One terrible day, the most ordinary English teacher Dasha Muratova will be forced to radically change her way of life. Without wanting it, she will become the head of a large Moscow pharmaceutical concern. Until that moment, its owner was her older brother Vladimir Muratov, but he died under mysterious circumstances. A yacht explosion took his life, his wife died with him, and a fire destroyed all the material evidence that shed light on the case. Grief-stricken Dasha is left with a growing orphan Katya and the largest pharmaceutical holding "Gipppokrat". In general - goodbye to the usual life in the provinces, high school, a big break and gatherings in the teachers' room with her friend Lariska - hello Moscow and the work of restoring and re-launching a mothballed medical plant. It won't be easy for the "Reluctant Pharmaceutical Queen" - she will have to take the pharmacy business with an iron fist, otherwise the "local mafia" has become too unruly. The plant's manager, Lidiya Sototskaya, produces her "left" drugs at the company's facilities, and each of the employees and friends is trying to keep
title: Богатая и любимая

overview: In the reality experiment, four cool personalities open the doors to their shared apartment in Munich. TV Casanova Yasin Mohamed meets TV celebrity Melina Hoch and Instagram icons Celina Weisner and Fabia Bengs.
title: La Familia - House of Reality

overview: Adam Richman combines his two great passions, food and football. He visits Britain's most famous teams and seeks out footie's finest foods.
title: Adam Richman Eats Football

overview: The Iberian lynx is one of the most beautiful and scarcest feline species in the world. On the verge of extinction, its population is slowly beginning to recover. Over the course of a year, this series reveals the intimate life of the Iberian lynx in the mountains of Sierra Morena, in Andalusia, southern Spain. Through breathtaking cinematography, the series follows the lynxes in their struggle for survival, from the thrill of the hunt to the tender moments of parenting, and witnesses the coexistence with other animals like majestic golden eagles, playful otters, vigilant rabbits or powerful deer. This wildlife series is a celebration of the comeback of this unique feline and a call to keep protecting it from the challenges of the future.
title: Land of the Iberian Lynx

overview: This series explore's the top 10 extraordinary abilities creatures have evolved to make it in the animal kingdom.
title: Nature's Ultimate Survivors

overview: In arid regions across Africa, a remarkable relationship between elephants and termites creates a waterhole – a green oasis which is central to every animal's life. The story follows an extraordinary community of creatures, that call the waterhole ‘home' over a season in their lives. They range from a family of elephants to a pair of hornbills (aka ‘Zazu' of The Lion King) alongside dung-beetles, chameleons, bullfrogs, geese and killifish.
title: Once Upon a Time in Tsavo

overview: Guy Martin: Proper Jobs is a four-part series commissioned for U&Dave and free streaming service, U. No stranger to trying new things, Guy Martin's Proper Jobs will see the motorcycle racer, truck fitter, part-time farmer, enthusiastic engineer and sometime television presenter, attempt a variety of different roles that involve a lot of hard graft, no shortage of skill and that perhaps don't get the recognition they deserve. Guy's not thinking about sitting behind a desk writing monthly highlights or sending a load of emails back and forth here though. No, he wants to get stuck in doing some of the most demanding jobs in the UK. Guy will fully immerse himself in his new role and undergo all the essential training, live with his co-workers, and by doing so, learn more about the people who do these jobs day in, day out. The former motorcycle racer will be able to see for himself the local and cultural significance these jobs have today and may have had in the past.
title: Guy Martin: Proper Jobs

overview: Gritty factual series revealing the work of elite police forces across the UK. Formerly titled Special Ops: Crime Squad UK, this behind-the-scenes docu-series follows the investigative work of a variety of specialist units within UK police forces created to crack the toughest of cases. From cyber heists, romance fraud and people trafficking to drugs rings and murder. The series boasts unique access to the highest-level detective techniques used to tackle crimes where ordinary policing has failed to make progress. This gritty but intelligent series reveals the workings of police operative units made up of the most elite detectives in the country. Filming with numerous task forces across the country, Special Ops: To Catch a Criminal reveals the real, lived experience of the police officers involved, through exclusive interviews, archive, CCTV and body cam footage.
title: Special Ops: To Catch a Criminal

overview: Contestants compete to win cash prizes in a mash-up of two game show formats, first by trying to match celebrities' answers to fill-in-the-blank questions and then by choosing to either agree or disagree with celebrities' answers to trivia questions.
title: Match Game Hollywood Squares Hour

overview: What unfolds when four of Korea's biggest stars swap their city lights for the raw wilds of Lapland, where even electricity and running water are a luxury? Brace yourself for a hilarious journey as the City Boys experience the self-sufficient lifestyle of local residents.
title: Rented in Finland

overview: Is a remarkable TV show that engages audiences in instigating topics within the contemporary universe of human behavior, love and sex. The variety show sparks conversation about delicate topics in an inclusive manner, celebrating differences and quirks of human sexuality, always keeping things light and fun, with comic stage dynamics and an informative tone.
title: Amor e Sexo

overview: A comedy story about a group of employees of a franchise supermarket Gąska, operating on the outskirts of a Polish city. It's a story about how it's easier, and definitely funnier, in a group.
title: Gąska

overview: Sense Appeal is a studio-based dating series that tests all five senses when it comes to choosing a partner. In each episode, singletons get to test the five senses on their potential matches before picking just one of them to take out on a date. They'll smell, touch, taste, hear, see and score their way to a match!
title: Sense Appeal

overview: This Christmas, Sky Arts goes behind the curtain with English National Ballet and their world premiere of a brand new production of Nutcracker. Having performed a version of the festive ballet every year since it was founded, this year sees the Company take a fresh approach, and the pressure is on to wow audiences more than ever before. This new series, Nutcracker: Backstage with English National Ballet showcases what it takes to re-invent a globally renowned classic, seen through the eyes of all the key departments involved. Join the Company's own Artistic Director and Choreographer, Aaron S. Watkin, and Olivier Award-winning Choreographer, Arielle Smith, as well Designer, Dick Bird, the principal dancers, musicians, Music Director and costumiers as they unpack their craft and prepare to stage this iconic ballet. Two documentaries follow the meticulous preparations and the all-important rehearsals which build to the opening night. Audiences can then tune in to the full performance of Nutcracker, captured in all its magic at the London Coliseum.
title: Nutcracker: Backstage with English National Ballet

overview: Olivia finds out how things work with fun experiments you can try at home.
title: Milkshake! Magic of Science

overview: Wildlife presenter Steve Backshall is on an adventure to find crocodiles in South Africa. With help from locals and experts, he dares to get close to some of these ancient creatures.
title: Milkshake! Croc Watch

overview: Arn has to endure so much before he can get the love of his life Cecilie, who has been put away in a monastery.
title: Arn - Tempelriddaren

overview: Tom Read Wilson puts brands to the test to see what the nation thinks of supermarket food.
title: The Taste Test Restaurant

overview: Sergei, a factory worker, was assigned to entertain Olga, an important guest from Moscow. And the hard worker couldn't think of anything smarter than to simulate an attempted abduction of a girl in the style of the nineties, where he could "save" her. The result is twofold: Olga fell in love with Sergei, but after she found out that the kidnapping was a fake, she decides to take revenge on her "savior" by extreme methods. And now Sergei has to fight the girl's attempts to put him in prison by her father, a colonel of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, who did not appreciate the prank of a provincial adventurer and his growing feelings for the girl.
title: Экстрим

overview: Following the runaway success of Muster Dogs, we check in on our human and canine stars to delve a little deeper into their lives and see what they've been up to since they competed to be crowned Champion Muster Dog.
title: Muster Dogs: Where Are They Now?

overview: Iconic music venue Whelan's on Dublin's Wexford street opens its doors to an eclectic mix of musical performances from a host of Irish greats, many who will be stopping off for a chat with host Dave Fanning.
title: Fanning at Whelans

overview: JuJu Watkins, along with her family and friends, gives viewers an exclusive look into USC Trojans guards' life and journey on and off the court.
title: On the Rise: JuJu Watkins

overview: The intimate account of a national team that has been the protagonist of one of the most surprising feats in the history of Spanish sport. Through four vibrant episodes, the frenetic pace of the competition and the coexistence of footballers with very different personalities converge in a story that takes your breath away.
title: Un equipo llamado España. El camino hacia la cuarta

overview: In the episodes of Őszinte leszek (I'll Be Honest), viewers can witness genuine exchanges of ideas where open-minded public figures, everyday people, and experts freely discuss topics such as artificial intelligence, food prices, bullying, or the urban-rural divide. Zsolt Osváth has already become known for sharing his honest opinions and staying true to himself, but in this show, his express goal is to spark thought-provoking conversations that encourage everyone to boldly share their own views, inspired by his insightful questions.
title: Őszinte leszek - Talkshow Osváth Zsolttal

overview: Comedians find the smartest answers to the dumbest questions.
title: Nobody Asked

overview: Set in contemporary Moscow and the frozen northern town of Archangel, the drama revisits the stark landscape of Communist Russia and takes place over four days in the life of academic Fluke Kelso. His fateful meeting with a former Stalinist bodyguard leads to the uncovering of one of the world's most dangerous and best kept secrets. He is led unwittingly through murder and intrigue towards his own personal "Holy Grail" - Joseph Stalin's secret legacy - a legacy that could change the face of Russian history forever.
title: Archangel

overview: Pop culture, politics, music, sport, society and media - Klaas Heufer-Umlauf comments on and discusses the really important topics and is completely subjective.
title: Late Night Berlin

overview: In turbulent early Republic of China, Hua Xiaoye, a compassionate acupuncturist, must clear her name after a warlord commander is killed in her clinic. She teams up with Leng Wensheng to uncover the truth.
title: Burning Frost Into Day

overview: Ji Gang Hui grew up at Motel California because her father ran the motel in her rural hometown village. Her mother also came from a mixed-raced background. Due to Gang Hui's unusual family background, she was the object of whispers and gossip by the local residents. Gang Hui carried a deep wound in her heart from that time. She liked her childhood friend Cheon Yeon Su, who was her first love, but when she turned 20, she left her hometown and moved to Seoul. 12 years later, she works as an interior designer and is reaching the apex of her career, but, for some reason, she decides to return to her hometown. She reunites with her first love, Cheon Yeon Su. Cheon Yeon Su works as a veterinarian in the village. The only woman he has loved is Gang Hui, but he has received a lot of attention from the farmers who are eager to introduce him to their daughters. In order to avoid these kind of uncomfortable situations, he doesn't clarify the rumor that he is going to marry a fellow veterinarian. His first love Gang Hui appears again after 12 years.
title: Motel California

overview: Dong Jin is recognized as the best in the field of data mining. The reason he majored in statistics at his university was because of Mi Jung and his wish to help her. Dong Jin and Mi Jung attended the same high school and he had crush on her, but she was called a witch. Since Mi Jung was little, strange things occurred around her like all the guys who liked her died or got injured. 10 years after school graduation, Dong Jin happens to meet Mi Jung again. She has now cut herself off from the world, believing her fate is cursed, but she wants to go out into the world. In hopes of Mi Jung breaking out of her shell, Dong in wants to prove that all these unfortunate incidents are not because of her. To prove his thesis, he investigates all the situations when guys around her got hurt. Risking his life, he finally finds the law of misfortune around her.
title: The Witch

overview: Queen Won Kyung, born to Min Je during the Goryeo period, came from a prestigious family of high-ranking officials. Married to Lee Bang Won, son of King Taejo, she supported her husband's ambitions to become King Taejong after his father bypassed him for the throne. As a kingmaker, she helped establish a new regime. However, their relationship soured after Lee Bang Won became king, took concubines, and sought to curb Queen Won Kyung's influence and that of her family.
title: The Queen Who Crowns

overview: Xia Xiaolan, a 36-year-old modern executive, finds herself in dire straits when her company collapses and she is forced to take the blame. In her despair, she finds herself transported into another world, becoming an 18-year-old beautiful villager. Her quick wit always manages to create miracles in desperate situations. Xiaolan forges ahead step by step, desperately seeking educational opportunities, believing that "knowledge changes destiny" is an unchanging maxim. Through her own efforts, she overcomes numerous difficulties and is admitted to her dream university. She also embarks on an entrepreneurial journey, starting with low-investment businesses like selling duck eggs and fried dough sticks, and progressing to clothing resales and real estate, quickly building her business acumen. Balancing studies and business, she also encounters a bittersweet romance. In this new spacetime, Xiaolan sheds her former reticence and embraces her destiny. She has a great lover by her side, close family and friends behind her, and loving elders and mentors. She also has a beloved career, hard-earned wealth, and a commitment to giving back to society. Xiaolan's rebirth is a transformative one, an adventurous journey through the business world. It is a lesson learned after experiencing changing times and the ups and downs of fate: whether in the past or present, only determination and courage are true keys to success. Fearless in the face of challenges, she ultimately achieves her goals with her head held high.
title: Dream of Golden Years

overview: Days of our Lives is set in the fictitious Midwestern town of Salem. The core families are the Bradys, the Hortons and the DiMeras, and the multi-layered storylines involve elements of romance, adventure, mystery, comedy and drama. Beginning on September 12, 2022, DAYS became exclusive to streaming on Peacock.
title: Days of Our Lives

overview: During World War II, women of all backgrounds work as spies: Krystyna Skarbek, the Polish aristocrat whose daring exploits earn her the title of "Churchill's favorite spy," Andrée de Jongh, the Belgian girl whose ambitious escape network will save hundreds of Allied airmen, Josephine Baker, the glamorous singer whose fame provides the perfect cover for her anti-Nazi activities, and brothel owner Kitty Schmidt, whose Nazi-run establishment offers both secrets and pleasures.
title: Female Spies: Courage and Espionage in WWII

overview: Explores Switzerland's most fascinating landscapes through railways. From vineyards to lakes to the most beautiful alpine valleys, travellers are offered breathtaking panoramas from train windows and wondrous insights into the country and its people.
title: Magical Train Journeys in Switzerland

overview: NITV News recaptures the highlights of Indigenous news around the country.
title: NITV News: Summer Yarns

overview: Thirty-five years on, the legacy of Lockerbie lives on. Hear eyewitness accounts from the families, friends and neighbours of those who tragically lost their lives in the most deadly terror attack in Britain.
title: After the Sky Fell on Lockerbie

overview: Mountain West Football Championship from 1999 to 2012, the champion of the Mountain West was determined by regular season record. Beginning in 2013, following the expansion to twelve members and the division of the conference into Mountain and West Divisions, the conference championship game was held between the two division winners. The Mountain West is one of four conferences to have its championship game at a campus site, along with the American Athletic Conference, Conference USA, and the Sun Belt Conference. The most recent 2022 championship game was the last to feature division winners. On May 20, 2022, the MW announced that it would eliminate its football divisions effective with the 2023 season, instead sending the top two teams in the conference standings to the title game. Two days earlier, the NCAA Division I Council had approved a rule change that gave all FBS conferences full freedom to determine the participants in their football championship games. The inaugural MW Championship Game was played on December 7, 2013, at Fresno State's Bulldog Stadium.
title: Mountain West Football Championship

overview: Meet both old favorites and new characters in this jam-packed sketch program with Björn Gustafsson.
title: Koppla av

overview: The romantic love story of Lin Yusen and Nie Xiguang follows the lively and energetic university student Nie Xiguang as she steps out of campus and navigates the challenges of the professional world. During university, she experiences a bittersweet secret crush on the aloof yet brilliant top student, Zhuang Xu. However, upon entering the workforce, she crosses paths with Lin Yusen, a former surgeon turned solar energy industry elite. Despite initial misunderstandings, Lin Yusen is irresistibly drawn to Nie Xiguang's radiant and warm personality. With his unwavering love and support, she lets go of past regrets and embraces the love she has always longed for. From being carefree and uncertain to setting clear career goals and striving forward, Nie Xiguang ultimately finds love, friendship, and personal growth, fulfilling both her dreams and her true self.
title: Shine on Me

overview: Presented by Fernanda Gentil, with Érico Brás in interviews and pictures, the program is for those who want to have fun and stay up to date with the best of the week in the world of celebrities.
title: Se Joga

overview: Factual stand-up series in which Craig Charles explores and goes behind the scenes at the 2nd annual Melbourne International Comedy Festival.
title: Craig Goes Mad in Melbourne

overview: 2046, Sardinia, Italy. Due to the extreme conditions brought upon by the climate change a severe Green Lockdown has been imposed: people are no longer allowed to go near Nature, the sea, woods and all natural landscapes are out of bounds.
title: Never Too Late

overview: Ana turns 30 on New Year's Eve, and she still hasn't figured out her life: she lives in a shared flat, she doesn't like her job, she often changes friends... Óscar turns 30 on New Year's Eve and has his life pretty much sorted out: he loves being a doctor, has loyal friends, and a relationship that comes and goes. On the night they both turn 30, they meet, fall in love and start a relationship with ups and downs that will last for ten years.
title: Los Años Nuevos
Dai Dao Shi Wei Su Xiao Li

overview: Pop culture gets gamed when Brian Miller, Eli Yudin, Carolyn Page, and special guests grab dice and turn your favorite movies and TV shows into tabletop RPGs.
title: TablePop

overview: The TablePop crew go live with an OG D&D game with a twist: you're a part of the adventure. It's a tabletop RPG with dungeons, monsters, epic battles, and you.
title: Tablepop Presents: Megadungeon Live!

overview: Join comedian Phoebe Robinson and cookbook author and culinary historian Max Miller as they put cookbook-obsessed chefs to the test with legendary cookbook-inspired challenges. Cookbooks are the cornerstone of how the average person has learned to cook for hundreds of years, testing the technical and creative skills of home cooks. In this competition, chefs from across the country take recipes from the page to the plate by cooking from history's greatest and the world's toughest cookbooks.
title: Clash of the Cookbooks

overview: Basketmouth hosts 10 of the funniest and craziest Nigerian comedians in a room for six hours. They will do anything possible to make each other laugh except laugh themselves. The last one laughing wins the game and 40,000,000 Naira for a charity of their choice.
title: LOL: Last One Laughing Naija

overview: For the first time in Colombia, LOL opens its doors to 10 of the best comedians to compete against each other to win the LOL trophy while they dare to make comedy free of censorship and limits. In this crazy extreme experiment, comedians will reveal much more than their repertoire of jokes. What will be their challenge? Make each of their opponents laugh while keeping a straight face.
title: LOL: Last One Laughing Colombia

overview: After meeting a vampire, the Shilov brothers discover their superpowers. Seryoga and Lyokha learn that the city's research institute houses a portal between the worlds of humans and evil spirits, who occasionally visit. The secret organization "Border of Worlds," led by Pavel Nikitich, oversees the werewolves, witches, mermaids, and other "tourists" from the Dark World. The team includes the "brain" of the organization, Lyudmila Nikolaevna, her daughter Sveta, and the striking vampire Ilona. The Shilovs become part of an unusual team, where they not only have to monitor the "dark" ones, but also collect fragments of a powerful artifact.
title: Граница миров
